about.title: Who I am
about.p1: I'm a Full Stack Software Engineer based in Brazil with over 4 years of experience delivering production-grade software for enterprise clients. My work spans backend systems, REST APIs, microservices architecture, and modern frontend applications.
about.p2_after: , I work on large-scale financial systems and banking platforms where reliability, security, and performance are non-negotiable. I care deeply about clean architecture, SOLID principles, and writing code that teams can evolve with confidence.
about.p3: I hold certifications in both AWS and Azure, and I'm comfortable working across the full stack — from database schema design to pixel-perfect UIs.

projectItems.title: App Spotify
projectItems.description: Web platform for music discovery and playback powered by YouTube, with Google OAuth login and playlist/subscription sync. Includes an embedded player (audio/video), search, Prisma-backed session persistence, and automatic token refresh.

projectItems.title: Finans
projectItems.description: Full-stack personal finance app with JWT auth, categories, paginated expenses, and a construction-costs module. Docker Compose setup (Postgres + NestJS + Nginx + React), Prisma migrations on startup, and a modern UI built with React Query + Tailwind/Shadcn.

projectItems.title: Upload S3 AWS
projectItems.description: Full-stack app for uploading and managing files on Amazon S3. NestJS backend with file validation, single/multi upload endpoints, and signed URL generation; Next.js frontend with drag-and-drop, listing, and preview. Monorepo structure with clear separation between API and UI.

projectItems.title: App Movies TMDB
projectItems.description: Full-featured web app to explore movies, TV shows, and people using the TMDB API. Rich detail pages (trailers, cast, recommendations), debounced search, pagination/infinite scroll, and React Query caching for great perceived performance. Responsive dark UI.

projectItems.title: AI Diet Agent
projectItems.description: Full-stack app that generates personalized diet plans using AI with real-time streaming via SSE (Server-Sent Events), delivering a ChatGPT-like experience. A NestJS backend orchestrates the generation and streams chunks; a Next.js frontend consumes it with EventSource and renders progressively.

projectItems.title: Google Ads AI Reporter
projectItems.description: Automated n8n workflow that pulls Google Ads campaign metrics and search terms, analyzes performance bottlenecks with an AI agent (OpenAI), and delivers an HTML report via Gmail. Demonstrates orchestration, data transformation, and practical business automation.

projectItems.title: NestJS + Kafka
projectItems.description: Practical async messaging example with Apache Kafka using NestJS: a REST API produces messages to a topic and a consumer processes events in real time. Includes docker-compose to run Kafka/Zookeeper locally, payload validation, and e2e tests to cover the end-to-end flow.
